lead.title: OpenAI says AI agents produced a Lean-checked proof that Navier-Stokes can blow up in finite time
lead.summary: Roughly 10,000 AI agents powered by a next-generation model reported to be more capable than GPT-6 Astra produced an analytical proof and Lean formalization showing the Navier-Stokes equations can develop a singularity in finite time. OpenAI says the run took 88 hours under strict isolation and that the result will steer how the lab paces future capability advances.

top_stories.title: GPT-6 Astra rolls out fully across Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers
top_stories.summary: Astra is now live in Codex and ChatGPT Work for paying users; OpenAI urged builders to ship demos on the new model ahead of next week's San Francisco event.

top_stories.title: Mistral raises €3B at >€21B post-money as sovereign AI becomes big business
top_stories.summary: Largest equity round ever by a European tech company, led by Samsung Electronics with EQT Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity; backers include a16z, Nvidia, Salesforce Ventures, Advent, BlackRock and Luxembourg.

top_stories.title: Cognition hits $48B valuation as investors bet AI coding isn't winner-take-all
top_stories.summary: $2B raised at nearly double the $26B mark of four months earlier, led by Andreessen Horowitz with Accel, Founders Fund, General Catalyst and Avenir; annualized run-rate revenue $900M, projected $4-5B by year-end.

top_stories.title: Altman opens applications for in-person GPT-6 event in San Francisco on September 16
top_stories.summary: The gathering will discuss GPT-6, next steps and celebrate with the community, modeled on the prior GPT-5.5 event format.

items.title: Nex-AGI releases Nex-N2.5 open-weights agentic family (Mini, Pro, Max)
items.summary: Apache 2.0 weights live on Hugging Face and ModelScope; Mini (35B multimodal), Pro (397B computer-use leader, 56.4 OSWorld-2) and Max (1.6T MoE, 50.2 on AutomationBench v1.0.6, 0.1 behind Claude Opus 5).

items.title: Nex-N2.5 Pro coming to OpenRouter with free tier
items.summary: Follow-up to the Nex-N2.5 family drop: Pro lands on OpenRouter with a free tier on September 9, extending the open-weights plus hosted-access dual strategy.

items.title: Zai's GLM-5.3-Flash 'Ox Alpha' takes open-weights efficiency crown
items.summary: The viral Ox Alpha model is Zai's GLM-5.3-Flash, a 320B-parameter hybrid linear-plus-sparse MoE (18B active), topping GDPval AA v2 at roughly $0.09 per task and trained on China-made hardware.

items.title: Nous Research ships first-class Hermes Agent support inside Omarchy
items.summary: Hermes Agent is now a first-class option inside Omarchy, the Arch-based agentic Linux distribution from DHH, reinforcing Nous Research's pivot from base-LLM fine-tunes toward an agent platform that runs third-party open-weights models locally.

items.title: MoEMB scales universal multimodal embeddings with efficient Mixture-of-Experts
items.summary: MoE architecture grows multimodal embedding capacity without proportional compute, achieving strong retrieval across vision-language and image-text benchmarks while keeping inference efficient.

items.title: Suan rectifies direct preference safety alignment in LLMs
items.summary: Rectified DPO formulation for safety alignment that addresses over-refusal and under-refusal trade-offs in open-weight models, claiming safety comparable to proprietary systems while preserving helpfulness.

items.title: Difficulty-adaptive tree-structured policy expansion for RLVR
items.summary: Extends RLVR for large reasoning models with a tree-structured policy that adapts difficulty per branch, showing measurable gains in pass@k and single-sample accuracy over GRPO on math and code benchmarks.

items.title: Environments as scaffold: enriching feedback to bootstrap self-evolving agents
items.summary: Argues enriching environment-side feedback (rather than only warming up the agent) mitigates reward sparsity in long-horizon RL training, with ablations on agentic benchmarks showing faster convergence.

items.title: OpenAI releases ChatGPT Images 2.5 with Flare and Sunburst variants
items.summary: Two new API models — GPT-Image-2.5 Flare (faster, default) and GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst (premium precision) — roll out across ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API with up to 50% lower latency than Images 2.0; Sketch drawing, templates and comment-on-image features land in ChatGPT.

items.title: DeepMind releases AlphaGenome Atlas mapping all 9 billion possible DNA letter changes
items.summary: 1-petabyte catalogue of precomputed AlphaGenome predictions for every possible single-nucleotide variant in the human genome, plus the new AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score; free for academic research via a portal, API and Google Antigravity.

items.title: Meta launches Muse consumer AI agent in the US with free and paid tiers
items.summary: Muse ships with a personal file system, terminal and browser, powered by Muse Spark 1.3; $20 and $100 paid tiers announced alongside a free tier — the launch comes days after Meta's $18B multistate settlement over consumer harms.

items.title: Sierra open-sources hyper-τ-Bench for agent construction
items.summary: Long-horizon benchmark that scores whether AI coding agents can build a working customer-service agent; even the strongest automated configuration scored under 24% on the paper.

items.title: Anthropic and OpenAI tighten enterprise data residency and retention policies
items.summary: Anthropic now lets business customers keep Claude traffic on their own servers for 30 days while OpenAI pitches Zero Data Retention via a new safety processing system; both flag automated misuse detection with limited public technical detail.

items.title: OpenAI signs multi-year Malaysia data-centre deal with Nvidia-backed Firmus
items.summary: Firmus announced OpenAI as anchor customer for two Malaysia AI Factory sites, pushing the Australian operator past 900 MW contracted capacity and bringing Nvidia Vera Rubin NVL72 rack-scale systems to Southeast Asia.

items.title: Arm launches Neoverse CSS N4 datacenter subsystem with up to 128 cores and LPDDR6
items.summary: Licensable datacenter compute subsystem with up to 128 cores per die, LPDDR6 memory and PCIe Gen 7, alongside an IDC-cited claim that Arm rack-scale servers now lead x86 in accelerated computing.

items.title: TSMC and ASML announce industry transition to large-format 12-inch photomasks for High-NA EUV
items.summary: Joint initiative to migrate High-NA EUV from current 6-inch masks to 12-inch masks, claiming a path to higher fab productivity and lower chipmaking costs; Samsung plans High-NA EUV adoption from 2028, TSMC from 2030.

items.title: Intel surpasses one million High-NA EUV wafers processed, outpaces the rest of industry combined
items.summary: Intel says it has processed more than one million 300-mm wafers on High-NA EUV scanners, more than the rest of the industry combined, and is pioneering 6x12-inch photomasks to remove the stitching constraint on next-generation chips.

items.title: Tau Robotics launches $30-an-hour humanoid cleaning service in San Francisco homes
items.summary: US startup began invite-only humanoid cleaning service using modified Unitree G1 units teleoperated from a control room; the company reports more than 50 homes serviced in roughly a month.

items.title: Lexroom makes its first acquisitions in France and Bulgaria
items.summary: Italian legal AI startup Lexroom acquired 100% of France's Query Juriste and Bulgaria's Praven Intelekt, expanding its data-first legal AI platform to five European markets; financial terms undisclosed.

items.title: Techshop SGR raises €43 million first close for Techshop II
items.summary: Italian VC firm exceeded its initial target; the fund will back Italian and European pre-seed and seed startups applying AI to B2B software and aims to raise €100 million by 2027.

items.title: To The Peak brings Europe's startup and deep-tech ecosystem to Bolzano
items.summary: Founder-focused summit opens September 9 with more than 1,000 expected participants from 21 countries, connecting startups, investors, companies and researchers around AI, deep tech, venture capital, sustainability and technology transfer.

items.title: eCampus opens AI and neuroscience lab inside former IBM facility
items.summary: Italy's eCampus University kicked off the NeuroLearning Interface project, combining AI, neuroscience and educational technology to develop adaptive and personalized learning models.

items.title: Forus raises $150M at $3B valuation to automate prescription-to-treatment workflows
items.summary: Series C led by Bain Capital Ventures with Thrive Capital, General Catalyst and Accel; AI agents handle operational workflow between prescription and treatment for nine of the top 15 biopharma; total raised now >$300M.

items.title: Blee raises $20M Series A to make AI-generated marketing governable
items.summary: Co-led by Fin Capital and SMBC Fin Atlas Beyond Fund with Hannah Grey VC, National Bank of Canada, Y Combinator and Penny Jar Capital; enterprise AI compliance platform for legal and brand teams reviewing AI-generated content, with SoFi and Expedia Group as customers.
